patch_description: This design keeps direct demand as the main link reward, but estimates relay quality from a proxy for link and node congestion rather than preferring relays with already-demanded legs. For each OD pair, it assigns a limited share of its two-hop reward across the most promising relays. Capping the total share helps avoid rewarding a topology repeatedly for providing many alternatives to the same traffic. The degree penalty remains evaluator-supplied and is set strongly to encourage feasible topologies.
